description: This file defines the enum LoanScheduleProcessingType, which specifies the types of processing (Horizontal or Vertical) applicable to loan schedules in the loan account domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanScheduleProcessingType
classes.description: An enumeration representing the mode of processing for loan schedules, providing methods to retrieve enum options and check the type.

methods.name: getValuesAsEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects representing all enum values with human-readable names.

methods.name: asEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts an enum constant into an EnumOptionData instance containing its id, name, and human-readable name.

methods.name: isHorizontal
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is HORIZONTAL.

methods.name: isVertical
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is VERTICAL.
